text:
Tara B.: quick postmortem follow-up — recurring midnight DB connection pressure keeps coming back. PM wants a tight runbook (first-10m play), explicit escalation lanes, and owners for each action so we can close the loop. who takes what?

Victor Q.: i can own the "first-10m" triage play and make it copy/paste safe. goal: 1 page, 6 checks, and 3 fast mitigations. i'll PR by 5 business days.

Sam L.: i'll take automation + safety hooks. plan: small health endpoint exposing conn_util, an alert annotation linking to the runbook, and an optional job-submission circuit-breaker. target due 2024-06-16.

Priyanka R.: i'll own the escalation lanes and the pager templates. proposal: keep thresholds as a tiny YAML (shared_constants/conn_thresholds.yaml) so alerts and runbook don't diverge. thresholds example: util >= 0.80 for 8m -> L2, util >= 0.94 for 2m -> L1 + exec. i'll add weekend fallback numbers. due 2024-06-11.

Tara B.: please also add a separate action to address the recurring root cause (overlapping bulk jobs). that should be assigned to app-team leads but we need a remediation plan and owner.

Victor Q.: initial triage checklist i'll add to the runbook:

```
# FIRST 10m PLAY (copy/paste)
# 1) check active DB connections
psql -c "SELECT now(), count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# 2) confirm connection errors in API logs
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | egrep -i "connection|denied|timeout"
# 3) check worker backlog
kubectl -n prod get jobs -l job=nightly -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, active:.status.active, failed:.status.failed}'
# 4) quick mitigation: pause job runner (feature-flag)
# 5) emergency mitigation: graceful restart of worker pool
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=90s
# 6) record trace IDs & attach to ticket
```

Sam L.: automation plan: expose conn_util at /internal/health/conn, add PromRule alert if conn_util > 0.82 for 5m, and annotate alert with runbook URL. i'll also prototype a CI smoke that curls the endpoint nightly. for the circuit-breaker: if conn_util > 0.85 for 3m, reject new job submissions for 10m. PM action: AUT-1221.

Priyanka R.: pager text i'll add to the runbook. sample: "DB conn_util {{value}} >= 0.94 for 2m. Run FIRST-10m play: <runbook_url>. If unresolved after mitigations, page infra-L1 and call ops-lead. If pager fails, call weekend fallback list." i'll include an example payload in the PR.

Link: https://tracker.redwood/RP-9001

Tara B.: PM wants owners + deliverables in tracker by EOD tomorrow. please confirm dates or update now. also, include a 2-line test plan in each PR so oncall can validate.

Victor Q.: confirmed. RP-9001 -> 2024-06-09. PR will include a 3-step validation for oncall and a rollback note.

Sam L.: confirmed. RP-9002 -> 2024-06-16. will include PromRule, alert annotation, example curl, and a tiny smoke job in CI.

Priyanka R.: confirmed. RP-9003 -> 2024-06-11. will add thresholds.yaml and example alert payloads.

Tara B.: good. i will open RP-9004 and ping app-team leads to assign job-staggering owner. scheduling a 20m runbook walkthrough with oncall after PRs land. weekly 15m syncs until all actions are green. tag RP-9001/9002/9003/9004 in PRs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
